HookId.description: A webhook's id: 16 random bytes in lowercase hex.

HookToken.description: The secret at the end of a webhook's address: 32 random bytes in lowercase hex. The host makes it and keeps it; the server keeps only its SHA-256.

HookAdd.description: A host asks for a webhook address that reaches it wherever it is.

url.description: The address senders post to, with the token at its end.

HookDeliveryId.description: One request a webhook received. Later requests to the same host have larger ids.

HookAccepted.description: The request is held for the host, which hears of it now or when it next connects, until a day has passed.

HookHeader.description: A request header, its name in lowercase.

HookDelivery.description: A request a webhook received, as the sender made it. The server checked only the token: a sender's signature is for the host to check.

query.description: The query string without its question mark, or empty.

body.description: The body's bytes in standard base64, at most 1 MiB of them.

HookChallenge.description: The server's first message on a webhook connection: a one-time value the host's hello signs.

HookRole.description: Only hosts connect for their webhooks.

HookHello.description: The host's first message: its key and its Ed25519 signature over the UTF-8 text `sikemux-hooks|<nonce>|<key>`.

HookReady.description: The hello was accepted. Requests the host has not finished follow, oldest first.

HookDelivered.description: A request for the host. It comes again, on this connection or the next, until the host answers it with done.

HookBye.description: The server is restarting and closes with HookCloseCode restarting after it. Reconnect no sooner than reconnectAfterMs.

HookDone.description: The host finished with a request. Handled, the server lets go of it; otherwise it comes again later, until a day after it arrived.

HookCloseCode.description: Why the server closed a webhook connection, as the WebSocket close code.

oneOf.title: badMessage
oneOf.description: The host sent something the protocol does not allow. Reconnect with backoff.

oneOf.title: unauthenticated
oneOf.description: The hello did not prove the host is on an account, or it was taken off it.

oneOf.title: helloTimeout
oneOf.description: No hello came within 10 seconds of the challenge. Reconnect with backoff.

oneOf.title: replaced
oneOf.description: A newer connection for the same host took over.

oneOf.title: idle
oneOf.description: The host has no webhooks and nothing waiting. Connect again once it adds one.

oneOf.title: overLimit
oneOf.description: Over a limit: more messages a second than allowed, or too many failed hellos from this key or address in a minute. Wait at least 30 seconds.

oneOf.title: serverError
oneOf.description: Something failed on the server. Reconnect with backoff.

oneOf.title: restarting
oneOf.description: The server is restarting, after a bye message. Reconnect no sooner than its reconnectAfterMs.

oneOf.title: overloaded
oneOf.description: The server has too many connections, or the host stopped reading. Reconnect with backoff.

HookServerMessage.description: What the server sends on a webhook connection.

HookClientMessage.description: What a host sends on a webhook connection.
